inputs.text: Full-length figure from head to feet, three-quarter front pose: a lean danava asura javelin thrower with dark charcoal-grey skin, small white tusks and pointed ears, a dented bronze scale cuirass over a dark maroon-brown wrap skirt, a low rounded bronze skullcap helmet hugging his head. His right hand grips a long barbed javelin drawn back above his shoulder ready to throw, his left arm stretched forward to aim. Sand-gold and dark bronze armour. Exactly two arms, the plain grey backdrop directly behind the helmet. Hades-style painterly cel-shaded game character art with bold dark ink outlines, hand-painted textures, saturated vivid colours and strong coloured rim lighting, with Indian miniature-painting ornament: fine gold-leaf detail and flat patterned colour fields on the clothing and armour, crisp black contour lines. Three-quarter top-down game sprite view, a single character, the entire figure visible from head to feet, standing on a plain flat light-grey background that fills the rest of the image.
